description: Coordinate research scope, dependencies, exclusive file ownership, resources and evidence-based acceptance.
Verify primary literature, implementation evidence, competing explanations and testable research hypotheses.
Audit data provenance, eligibility, labels, duplicates and grouping before constructing research cohorts.
Define explicit contracts for converting observations into features, tokens, poses or embeddings.
Implement accepted ML methods, controlled variants, training checks and separately identified runs.
Design leakage-resistant comparisons, frozen endpoints, valid aggregation and honest uncertainty estimates.
Design and evaluate agent workflows, delegation, tool use, memory and recovery against matched baselines.
Independently replay research artifacts with explicit environments, inputs, seeds, commands and cache validity.
Integrate reliable reusable APIs and execution machinery while preserving study and repository ownership boundaries.
Create clear progressive research tutorials with runnable examples, explicit prerequisites and evidence-backed explanations.
Create editable scientific diagrams and provenance-linked figures, then inspect rendered outputs for accuracy and readability.
Independently challenge research methods, implementation, evidence, claims and final artifact completeness.
